description_sq:
Rr. Dritan Hoxha, Shesim Godine Biznesi Komerciale.
Godina ndodhet buze rruges kryesore, ne nje vendodhje shume te favorshme dhe shume prane Qendres se qytetit, gjithashtu dhe me akses shume thjeshte dhe direkt me rruget kryesore, si Autostrada Tirane - Durres, Aeroporti Nene Tereza, Unaza e Madhe etj.
Objekti eshte i struktuar nga 9 kate mbi toke, ku secili kat ka siperfaqe 360m2 dhe 1 kat nentoke me siperfaqe 1160m2 ku ka hapesire per 40 poste parkimi.
Godina ne pjesen e jashtme eshte e ndertuar me fasade te ventiluar dhe pjesa tjeter me fasade termike, investim i cili e ben godinen te kete eficence te larte te kursimit te energjise elektrike. Vlen per tu permendur qe nje pjese e konsumit te energjise mbulohet nga investimi i bere ne panele fotovoltaike ne taracen e godines.
Objekti ploteson te gjithe standartet e sigurise qe kerkohen nga institucionet nderkombetare per godinat civile; dalje dhe shkalle emergjence te jashtme, sistem ndihmes per personat me aftesi te kufizuar etj.
Aksesi ne katet e siperme te godines behet nepermjet dy ashensoreve ose shkalleve te brendshme.
Organizimi nga kati 1 deri ne katin 8 eshte openspace me lartesi kati 4m dhe kati 0 me lartesi 5m. Ndarjet ne kate jane bere me mure gipsi dhe ndarje xhami sipas nevojave te biznesit aktual qe operon ne godine.
Ne objekt eshte i instaluar sistem konidicionimi dhe aspirimi qendror per te gjithe godinen.
Furnizimi me uje dhe energji elektrike eshte i garantuar 24 ore pa nderprerje dhe ne raste emergjente godina eshte e pajisur edhe me gjenerator.
Ne aspektin e sigurise jane investuar sistem monitorimi me kamera, sistem alarmi, sistem detekor tymi etj.
Godina eshte e pershtatshme per aktivitete te ndryshme per Koorporata apo Kompani te medha.
Aktualisht eshte e dhene me qira per nje afat 9-vjeçar.
Per me shume informacion, me kontaktoni!
title_en: DRITAN HOXHA STREET, COMMERCIAL BUILDING FOR SALE
description_en: St. Dritan Hoxha, Shesim Godine Commercial Business. The building is located on the edge of the main road, in a very favorable location and very close to the city center, also with very easy and direct access to the main roads, such as the Tirana - Durres highway, Mother Teresa Airport, the Great Ring Road, etc. The building consists of 9 floors above ground, where each floor has an area of ​​360m2 and 1 underground floor with an area of ​​1160m2 where there is space for 40 parking spaces. The exterior of the building is built with a ventilated facade and the other part with a thermal facade, an investment that makes the building highly efficient in saving electricity. It is worth mentioning that part of the energy consumption is covered by the investment made in photovoltaic panels on the roof of the building. The facility meets all safety standards required by international institutions for civil buildings; external emergency exits and stairs, assistance system for people with disabilities, etc. Access to the upper floors of the building is through two elevators or internal stairs. The organization from floor 1 to floor 8 is open space with a floor height of 4m and floor 0 with a height of 5m. The partitions on the floors are made with plaster walls and glass partitions according to the needs of the current business operating in the building. A central air conditioning and aspiration system is installed in the building for the entire building. The supply of water and electricity is guaranteed 24 hours without interruption and in case of emergency the building is also equipped with a generator. In terms of security, a monitoring system with cameras, an alarm system, a smoke detector system, etc. have been invested. The building is suitable for various activities for large corporations or companies. It is currently leased for a period of 9 years. For more information, contact me!
